mode.title: Processing Mode
mode.description: Choose how to provide reels for analysis

reel_id.title: Reel ID (Single Mode)
reel_id.description: Required for Single Mode: Unique identifier for the reel

video_url.title: Video URL (Single Mode)
video_url.description: Required for Single Mode: Direct URL to the video file

caption.title: Caption
caption.description: Reel caption text (optional for Single Mode)

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Array of hashtags (optional for Single Mode)

supabase_url.title: Supabase URL (Batch Mode)
supabase_url.description: Required for Batch Mode: Your Supabase project URL

supabase_key.title: Supabase Service Role Key (Batch Mode)
supabase_key.description: Required for Batch Mode: Your Supabase service role key

batch_limit.title: Batch Limit
batch_limit.description: Max number of reels to process in batch mode (default: 10)

filter_unanalyzed_only.title: Only Unanalyzed Reels
filter_unanalyzed_only.description: In Batch Mode: only process reels without existing analysis

analysis_window_seconds.title: Analysis Window (seconds)
analysis_window_seconds.description: How many seconds of video to analyze (default: 5)

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API Key
openrouter_api_key.description: OpenRouter API key (or use OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable)

google_sheets_id.title: Google Sheets ID (optional)
google_sheets_id.description: Optional: Google Sheets ID to save results. Leave empty to skip.

google_service_account_json.title: Google Service Account JSON (optional)
google_service_account_json.description: Optional: Google Service Account credentials as JSON string
